choices.description: Return the manuscript to Scholar Yusuf

title: The Palace Audience
description: Present yourself to the royal court. Will you approach as a scholar of language, or as a merchant bearing gifts?
descriptionArabic: قَدِّم نَفسَكَ لِلبَلاط المَلَكي. هَل تَقتَرِبُ كَعالِمِ لُغَة أَم كَتاجِرٍ يَحمِلُ هَدايا؟

choices.description: Present yourself as a scholar seeking wisdom
choices.descriptionArabic: قَدِّم نَفسَكَ كَعالِمٍ يَبحَثُ عَن الحِكمَة

choices.description: Present yourself as a merchant bearing exotic gifts
choices.descriptionArabic: قَدِّم نَفسَكَ كَتاجِرٍ يَحمِلُ هَدايا غَريبَة

title: The Court's Verdict

descriptionArabic: بِغَضِّ النَّظَر عَن طَريقَتِك، يَعتَرِفُ البَلاط بِإِتقانِكَ لِلعَرَبِيَّة. الاِختِبار الأَخير يَنتَظِر

title: The Lost Chapter
description: Librarian Ibrahim discovers a missing chapter from an ancient grammar book. Help him piece together the fragments.
descriptionArabic: أَمين المَكتَبَة إبراهيم يَكتَشِفُ فَصلاً مَفقوداً مِن كِتاب نَحوٍ قَديم. ساعِدهُ في تَجميع الأَجزاء

title: The Market Rivalry
description: Spice Seller Layla and Trader Hassan are in a trade dispute. Use your vocabulary to mediate.
descriptionArabic: بائِعَة التَّوابِل لَيلى وَالتّاجِر حَسَّان في خِلاف تِجاري. اِستَخدِم مُفرَداتِكَ لِلتَّوَسُّط

title: The Bedouin Star Map
description: Storyteller Noor tells of a star map that reveals hidden paths. Learn the Arabic names of stars to unlock its secrets.
descriptionArabic: الحَكّاءَة نور تُخبِرُ عَن خَريطَة نُجوم تَكشِفُ طُرُقاً مَخفِيَّة. تَعَلَّم أَسماء النُّجوم بِالعَرَبِيَّة لِفَتح أَسرارِها

title: The Healer's Trial
description: Healer Khadija tests your knowledge of body and health vocabulary to earn her trust and unlock healing recipes.
descriptionArabic: المُعالِجَة خَديجَة تَختَبِرُ مَعرِفَتَكَ بِمُفرَدات الجِسم وَالصِّحَّة لِتَكسِبَ ثِقَتَها وَتَفتَح وَصَفات العِلاج

title: The Scholar's Calling
description: Guide Amira reveals that a cosmic sandstorm has scattered 8 pages of an ancient manuscript across the land — and only a time-traveling scholar can recover them.
descriptionArabic: تَكشِفُ المُرشِدَة أَميرَة أَنَّ عاصِفَة رَمليَّة كَونيَّة بَعثَرَت ثَمانيَ صَفَحات مِن مَخطوطَة قَديمَة عَبرَ الأَرض

objectives.description: Listen to Guide Amira's account of the scattered manuscript
objectives.descriptionArabic: اِستَمِع إلى رِوايَة المُرشِدَة أَميرَة عَن المَخطوطَة المُبَعثَرَة

objectives.description: Locate the first manuscript page hidden in the oasis ruins
objectives.descriptionArabic: اعثُر عَلى الصَّفحَة الأُولى مِن المَخطوطَة المَخبوءَة في أَطلال الواحَة

objectives.description: Decipher the opening Arabic verse inscribed on the page
objectives.descriptionArabic: افكُكَّ البَيتَ الشِّعري العَرَبيّ الأَوَّل المَنقوش عَلى الصَّفحَة

lore: The oasis of Bayt al-Hikma mirrors the real House of Wisdom in Abbasid Baghdad, where scholars translated Greek, Persian, and Indian texts into Arabic during the Golden Age.

title: The Library's Cipher
description: Librarian Ibrahim holds the key to deciphering the second manuscript page locked inside the ancient library's cipher room.
descriptionArabic: يَحمِلُ المَكتَبيُّ إبراهيم مِفتاح فَكِّ شِفرَة الصَّفحَة الثّانيَة المَحبوسَة في غُرفَة التَّشفير بِالمَكتَبَة القَديمَة

objectives.description: Locate the hidden cipher room in the ancient library
objectives.descriptionArabic: اعثُر عَلى غُرفَة التَّشفير المَخفيَّة في المَكتَبَة القَديمَة

objectives.description: Decipher 3 Arabic root words inscribed on the second page
objectives.descriptionArabic: افكُكَّ ثَلاثَة جُذور عَرَبيَّة مَنقوشَة عَلى الصَّفحَة الثّانيَة

lore: The Abbasid library system, culminating in Bayt al-Hikma, classified books using abjad numerals — the same root-word system the page's cipher is based on.

title: The Market Bargain Scroll
description: Merchant Fatima has unknowingly wrapped goods in the third manuscript page — the scholar must negotiate its return through the art of Arabic market speech.
descriptionArabic: لَفَّت التّاجِرَة فاطِمَة بَضاعَتَها بِالصَّفحَة الثّالِثَة مِن المَخطوطَة — يَجِبُ عَلى العالِم استِعادَتُها بِفَنِّ الحِوار التِّجاري

objectives.description: Identify the manuscript page among Fatima's market wares
objectives.descriptionArabic: حَدِّد صَفحَة المَخطوطَة بَينَ بَضائِع فاطِمَة في السُّوق

objectives.description: Use market Arabic to negotiate the page's return from the merchant
objectives.descriptionArabic: استَخدِم لُغَة السُّوق العَرَبيَّة لِلتَّفاوُض عَلى اسِتِعادَة الصَّفحَة

objectives.description: Read aloud the trade verse on the third page to unlock its meaning
objectives.descriptionArabic: اِقرَأ بَيتَ التِّجارَة عَلى الصَّفحَة الثّالِثَة بِصَوت عالٍ لِفَكِّ مَعناهُ

lore: The desert marketplace reflects the great Islamic trade routes stretching from Andalusia to the Silk Road, where Arabic became the lingua franca of commerce.

title: The Harvest Clue
description: Farmer Omar discovered a manuscript page buried in his field during harvest season — its agricultural verses hold clues to the next page's location.
descriptionArabic: عَثَرَ المُزارِع عُمَر عَلى صَفحَة مِن المَخطوطَة مَدفونَة في حَقلِهِ أَثناءَ الحَصاد — أَبياتُها الزِّراعيَّة تَحمِلُ إشارات لِمَوقِع الصَّفحَة التّاليَة

objectives.description: Help Farmer Omar complete the harvest to earn his trust
objectives.descriptionArabic: ساعِدِ المُزارِع عُمَر في إتمام الحَصاد لِتَكسِبَ ثِقَتَه

objectives.description: Read the agricultural Arabic verse inscribed on the fourth page
objectives.descriptionArabic: اِقرَأ البَيتَ الزِّراعي العَرَبي المَنقوش عَلى الصَّفحَة الرّابِعَة

lore: Islamic agricultural science produced Al-Filaha al-Nabatiyya and Ibn al-Awwam's Kitab al-Filaha — comprehensive farming encyclopedias that transformed Andalusian agriculture.

title: The Bedouin Night Vision
description: Wanderer Ali glimpsed the fifth manuscript page falling from the sky during a desert night — he hid it among the stars, encoded in the Bedouin navigation songs he knows by heart.
descriptionArabic: رَأى الرَّحّالَة عَليّ الصَّفحَة الخامِسَة تَسقُطُ مِن السَّماء ذات لَيلَة — أَخفاها في النُّجوم مُشَفَّرَةً في أَغاني المَلّاحَة البَدَويَّة

objectives.description: Learn the Bedouin navigation song that encodes the page's location
objectives.descriptionArabic: تَعَلَّم أُغنيَة المَلّاحَة البَدَويَّة التي تُشَفِّر مَوقِع الصَّفحَة

objectives.description: Decode the star-navigation verse on the fifth manuscript page
objectives.descriptionArabic: افكُكَّ بَيتَ مَلّاحَة النُّجوم عَلى الصَّفحَة الخامِسَة

lore: Bedouin navigators memorised hundreds of star names in Arabic — many still used today, such as Altair (al-nasr al-tair, the flying eagle) and Aldebaran (al-dabaraan, the follower).

title: The Healer's Secret Page
description: Healer Khadija has kept the sixth manuscript page for years, believing its medical Arabic verses could cure a mysterious illness — she will only part with it if the scholar can read its prescriptions aloud.
descriptionArabic: احتَفَظَت المُعالِجَة خَديجَة بِالصَّفحَة السّادِسَة لِسَنَوات، مُؤمِنَةً بِأَنَّ أَبياتَها الطِّبيَّة العَرَبيَّة قادِرَة عَلى علاج مَرَض غامِض

objectives.description: Earn Healer Khadija's trust by demonstrating knowledge of healing vocabulary
objectives.descriptionArabic: اكسِب ثِقَة المُعالِجَة خَديجَة بِإِظهار مَعرِفَتِكَ بِمُفرَدات الشِّفاء

objectives.description: Read aloud the medical Arabic verse on the sixth page to prove its safety
objectives.descriptionArabic: اِقرَأ البَيتَ الطِّبيَّ العَرَبي عَلى الصَّفحَة السّادِسَة لِإِثبات سَلامَتِه

lore: Ibn Sina's Canon of Medicine (al-Qanun fi al-Tibb) was written in Arabic and remained the standard medical text in Europe and the Islamic world until the 17th century.

title: The Navigator's Compass
description: Captain Rashid retrieved the seventh manuscript page from the sea but cannot read its nautical Arabic — the scholar must translate it before the next tide carries the final clue away.
descriptionArabic: أَنقَذَ القُبطان رَشيد الصَّفحَة السّابِعَة مِن البَحر لَكِنَّهُ لا يَستَطيعُ قِراءَة عَرَبيَّتِها البَحريَّة — يَجِبُ عَلى العالِم تَرجَمَتُها قَبلَ أَن يَحمِلَ المَدُّ التّالي الخَيطَ الأَخير

objectives.description: Meet Captain Rashid at the dock and examine the waterlogged manuscript page
objectives.descriptionArabic: قابِل القُبطان رَشيد عِندَ الرَّصيف وَافحَص صَفحَة المَخطوطَة المُبلَّلَة

objectives.description: Translate the nautical Arabic verse to reveal the royal palace coordinates
objectives.descriptionArabic: تَرجِم البَيتَ البَحريَّ العَرَبيَّ لِلكَشف عَن إحداثيَّات القَصر المَلَكي

lore: Arab navigator Ahmad ibn Majid wrote over 40 nautical texts in verse form, using Arabic poetry as a mnemonic for sailing routes — the same technique used in this manuscript page.

title: The Final Assembly
description: Scholar Yusuf at the royal palace holds the eighth and final page — reassembling all 8 pages reveals an ancient Arabic poem that unlocks the manuscript's cosmic secret.
descriptionArabic: يَحمِلُ الشَّيخ يوسُف في القَصر المَلَكي الصَّفحَة الثّامِنَة والأَخيرَة — إعادَة تَجميع كُلِّ الصَّفَحات الثَّماني تَكشِفُ قَصيدَةً عَرَبيَّة قَديمَة

objectives.description: Present the seven recovered pages to Scholar Yusuf at the royal palace
objectives.descriptionArabic: قَدِّم الصَّفَحات السَّبع المُسترَدَّة إلى الشَّيخ يوسُف في القَصر المَلَكي

objectives.description: Receive the eighth page from Scholar Yusuf and complete the manuscript
objectives.descriptionArabic: استَلِم الصَّفحَة الثّامِنَة مِن الشَّيخ يوسُف وَأَتِمَّ المَخطوطَة

objectives.description: Recite the complete ancient Arabic poem aloud to unlock its cosmic secret
objectives.descriptionArabic: أَنشِدِ القَصيدَة العَرَبيَّة القَديمَة كامِلَةً بِصَوت عالٍ لِفَكِّ سِرِّها الكَوني

lore: The Bayt al-Hikma in Baghdad housed over 400,000 manuscripts before the Mongol invasion of 1258 CE — many texts survived only because scholars memorised and transcribed them by heart.
